svg.title: All thirty-six stationary depth-two portraits
svg.desc: Every panel repeats its own base label (i,j) twice, showing P at depth two with I=(i,i) and J=(j,j) in square coordinates. Each of the 36 portraits contains exactly 256 cells in a 96 by 96 target grid. The row and column order is the base display order, but these selected depth-two portraits are not a complete order-36 geomagic array or one of its tiling lines.

g.text: Repeat each label twice: I = (i,i), J = (j,j). Every portrait has 256 cells in its own 96 × 96 target.
These portraits share the same limiting dimension, but they are selected pieces rather than a complete tiling line.
Colours identify display columns only. The sector words, quantum-colour words and signs are not displayed.
